name: address
title: Address
description: A physical address for an organisational unit or person.
rdfs:comment: A physical address for an organisational unit or person.

fields.name: address_pk
fields.title: Address (Primary Key)
fields.description: A unique identifier for an ltc:Address.
fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to guarantee uniqueness.
fields.rdfs:comment: A unique identifier for an ltc:Address.

fields.name: organisationalUnit_fk
fields.title: Organisational Unit (Foreign Key)
fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key). Optional: a row belongs to exactly one parent, so populate exactly one of this table's parent foreign keys.
fields.rdfs:comment: This property refers to one or more related instances of the Address class.

fields.name: person_fk
fields.title: Person (Foreign Key)
fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key). Optional: a row belongs to exactly one parent, so populate exactly one of this table's parent foreign keys.
fields.rdfs:comment: This property refers to one or more related instances of the Address class.

fields.name: personRole_fk
fields.title: Person Role (Foreign Key)
fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key). Optional: a row belongs to exactly one parent, so populate exactly one of this table's parent foreign keys.
fields.rdfs:comment: This property refers to one or more related instances of the Address class.

fields.name: storageLocation_fk
fields.title: Storage Location (Foreign Key)
fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key). Optional: a row belongs to exactly one parent, so populate exactly one of this table's parent foreign keys.
fields.rdfs:comment: This property refers to one or more related instances of the Address class.

fields.name: addressCountry
fields.title: Address Country
fields.description: The country. For example, USA. You can also provide the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
fields.comments: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary -- e.g. current ISO 3166 Country Codes.
fields.rdfs:comment: The country. For example, USA. You can also provide the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

fields.name: addressLocality
fields.title: Address Locality
fields.description: The locality in which the street address is, and which is in the region. For example, Mountain View.
fields.comments: The locality in which the address is located. AddressLocality is a more specific geographic area than addressRegion.
fields.rdfs:comment: The locality in which the street address is, and which is in the region. For example, Mountain View.

fields.name: addressRegion
fields.title: Address Region
fields.description: The region in which the locality is, and which is in the country. For example, California or another appropriate first-level Administrative division.
fields.rdfs:comment: The region in which the locality is, and which is in the country. For example, California or another appropriate first-level Administrative division.

fields.name: addressType
fields.title: Address Type
fields.description: A person or organization can have different addresses, for different purposes. For example, a postal address, a loan address, an address for visits and so on. This property is used to specify the kind of address.
fields.rdfs:comment: A person or organization can have different addresses, for different purposes. For example, a postal address, a loan address, an address for visits and so on. This property is used to specify the kind of address.

fields.name: postOfficeBoxNumber
fields.title: Post Office Box Number
fields.description: The post office box number for PO box addresses.
fields.rdfs:comment: The post office box number for PO box addresses.

fields.name: streetAddress
fields.title: Street Address
fields.description: The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.
fields.examples: `Invalidenstraße 43`, `1400 S. Du Sable Lake Shore Dr`, `960 Carling Avenue`
fields.rdfs:comment: The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.
